episode_summary: In this episode, Sam Burke shares his journey from a young real estate agent to a top producer, emphasizing the importance of consistent quality in service and strategic use of social media for lead generation. He discusses his investment strategies and the role of mindset in achieving success, offering actionable insights for agents at all stages of their careers.
